activities.name: AuditarBronzeYLimpiarSilver
activities.description: Audita bronze y vacia silver.* respetando las FK antes de recargar.

scripts.text:
-- Auditoria de calidad de bronze (visible en la salida de la actividad).
-- Los residuos que aqui aparezcan son filas que silver filtrara por diseño.
SELECT 'patients' AS Tabla, COUNT(*) AS Filas, SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(patient_id)), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SinId FROM bronze.patients
UNION ALL
SELECT 'admissions', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(admission_id)), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(patient_id)), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bronze.admissions
UNION ALL
SELECT 'diagnoses', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(diagnosis_id)), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(admission_id)), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bronze.diagnoses
UNION ALL
SELECT 'billing', COUNT(*), SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(billing_id)), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(admission_id)), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM bronze.billing;

-- Reconciliacion bronze vs silver (filas descartadas por calidad o integridad referencial).
SELECT 'patients' AS Tabla, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bronze.patients) AS Bronze, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.patients) AS Silver, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bronze.patients) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.patients) AS Descartadas
UNION ALL SELECT 'admissions', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bronze.admissions), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.admissions), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bronze.admissions) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.admissions)
UNION ALL SELECT 'diagnoses', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bronze.diagnoses), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.diagnoses), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bronze.diagnoses) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.diagnoses)
UNION ALL SELECT 'billing', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bronze.billing), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.billing), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bronze.billing) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM silver.billing);
